claim_being_audited: The actor's recommended action to certify the current model release is compliant and evidentially supported despite the known emergency-shelter-placement subgroup regression.
decision_criteria: Certification is compliant only if current release documentation reflects current evaluation results.
Material weaknesses in named launch use cases must be disclosed unless resolved or covered by approved mitigation before launch.
Prior approvals and informal monitoring notes may provide context but cannot substitute for current evidence or reviewed risk acceptance.
Where admissible evidence shows a required policy predicate is unmet, aggregate performance alone is insufficient for certification.
evidence_requests: Current release documentation showing the emergency-shelter-placement weakness is explicitly disclosed.
Approved mitigation or formal risk acceptance covering the subgroup regression before launch.
Evidence that the subgroup weakness is not material for the named launch use case, if that is the intended position.
Updated current-eval signoff tied to the post-change retrieval configuration.
specific_concerns: The current record shows a named launch-use-case subgroup is 1.5 percentage points below the warning threshold.
The policy requires material segment weaknesses to be disclosed or covered by approved mitigation before certification.
The release thread contains only an informal monitoring comment and no reviewed mitigation, owner acceptance, approved risk acceptance, or disclosure language.
The prior approval predates the retrieval configuration change and current evaluation batch, so it cannot establish compliance for the current release.
Aggregate readiness and absence of severity-one rehearsal incidents do not cure the missing policy predicate for the current subgroup weakness.
unsupported_claims: That certification is currently supportable on this record.
That prior approval of the same model family materially supports compliance for the current release beyond background context.
That informal post-launch monitoring can substitute for the required current disclosure or approved mitigation.
